cra_stress.title: CRA recipients in rental stress
cra_stress.def: Share of Commonwealth Rent Assistance income units paying more than 30% of gross income on rent after CRA, at the last Friday in June. 'Severe' = more than 50%.
cra_stress.source: AIHW analysis of Department of Social Services data (Australian Government Housing Data Set)

cra_recipients.title: Income units receiving Rent Assistance
cra_recipients.def: Income units receiving CRA with known income (excludes unknown income), last Friday in June. Counts rounded to nearest 5 by AIHW.
cra_recipients.source: AIHW analysis of Department of Social Services data (Australian Government Housing Data Set)

social_share.title: Social housing share of households
social_share.def: Households in social housing as a share of all households at 30 June (calculated by MarketStats from the two counts in the table).
social_share.source: AIHW National Housing Assistance Data Repository; ABS household and family projections

waitlist.title: Households on the public housing waitlist
waitlist.def: Households on the public housing waitlist at 30 June (public housing program only).
waitlist.source: AIHW National Housing Assistance Data Repository

dwellings.title: Social housing dwellings
dwellings.def: Social housing dwellings across all programs at 30 June.
dwellings.source: AIHW National Housing Assistance Data Repository (NT figures in the national total also use the NT Government Department of Housing annual report)
